column1: # REST contract between web-interface/js/api.js and firmware WebApi.cpp.
# One row per endpoint. Tab- or multi-space separated; `-` means "none".
#   path        the registered route. A trailing / marks a path parameter
#               (/api/board/<id>): the firmware registers one route per value.
#   request     fields the handler MUST read from the body, or @body when the whole
#               body is the payload (a profile) and the check is that it is parsed
#               at all. This column is the
#               point of the file: /api/pins/auto existed, was called with a
#               `board` field, and ignored it — handing out ESP32-S3 pins whichever
#               board you had selected. Route-only checking cannot see that; a
#               required request field the handler never reads is exactly it.
#   response    fields the handler MUST write, so the UI can rely on them. Prefix
#               with `helper:` when a named helper writes them — /api/status serves
#               a snapshot built by WebApi::fillStatus, deliberately, so the REST
#               route and the WebSocket broadcast cannot drift apart.
# Optional request fields are deliberately NOT listed: this file states what a
# handler cannot be correct without, not everything it may accept.
